from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One document in the collection, identifying its own title and which other provided papers it cites."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this specific document")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that this document references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all documents from the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
